# Azure Monitor Activity Log

Query Azure Monitor Activity Log events and retrieve category metadata for one subscription using delegated Microsoft OAuth.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/azure-monitor-activity-log/.

## Actions

- **List Activity Log Events** (read-only): Return one page of Activity Log events for a UTC time range from the subscription selected when the Azure connection was created.
- **List Event Categories** (read-only): Return the Activity Log event categories recognized by Azure, including their localized labels when available.
